text: Receive packets from the higher layers that need to be transmitted toward a receiver. Okay, so the MAC layer gets these packets. When a packet arrives at the MAC layer, the MAC layer understands that it has to do something to then let the packet be transmitted. And be transmitted means that the packet needs to go down the physical layer. Here we have modulation, etc. And then the antenna through which the bits impressed on the electromagnetic signal will be transmitted. And they will reach the signal will reach the physical layer at the receiver. The physical layer performs demodulation. Then if we consider that the packet is received successfully, it will go up through these layers. Okay, now Wi-Fi indeed as we said specifies what the physical and MAC layer, and the transmitter and the receiver do. Now our transmitter may be a user Wi-Fi card that transmits toward the access point. Or we may have the access point that transmits toward the user Wi-Fi card. Okay, now.
